title: Good Quality
text: Good Quality. I like using wax melts in my home. It's a safer alternative to candles. These are pretty small. I used 2 of them at a time in my wax melting pot. The quality seems to be good. I found the scent strong. It smelled more nutty to me than coconutty. At first, I was pleased with the scent, but after a while it became overwhelming. I know that scent is a personal thing for people. I usually love strong scents, so that kind of surprised me. I wouldn't be opposed to trying other scents by this brand.
